description: This file defines utility functions and classes for Java interoperability within Apache Spark, including converting Scala collections to Java Serializable maps and handling Option types.

classes.name: SerializableMapWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that makes Scala maps serializable and implements Java's Map interface.

methods.name: optionToOptional
methods.description: Converts a Scala Option to a Java Optional.

methods.name: mapAsSerializableJavaMap
methods.description: Wraps a Scala collection Map as a serializable Java Map.
